<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* ================================================================
   CAMPUS360 GLOBAL SERVICE NOW DESIGNER RECOVERY
   Applies to Campus360 portal pages

   Page IDs:
   placement_readiness
   mock_interview_booking
   campus360_training
   campus360_student_dashboard
   campus360_opportunities
   campus360_interviews
   campus360_trainer_profile
   campus360_trainer_dashboard
   campus360_trainer_my_training
   campus360_trainer_mock_slots
   campus360_trainer_interview_feedback
   campus360_trainer_placement_intelligence
   campus360_trainer_opportunities

   PUT THIS AT THE VERY BOTTOM OF:
   CAMPUS360 THEME → STYLE SHEET
   ================================================================ */


/* ================================================================
   1. RESTORE SERVICENOW NAVBAR / HEADER
   ================================================================ */

#sp-nav,
#sp-header,
.sp-navbar,
.sp-header,
.sp-header-bar,
.sp-nav,
.sp-nav-bar,
.portal-header,
nav.navbar,
.navbar.navbar-default,
header.navbar,
header[role="banner"],
nav[role="navigation"] {
    display: revert !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   2. RESTORE PAGE DESIGNER / EDITOR
   ================================================================ */

.sp-page-designer,
.sp-page-editor,
.page-designer,
.page-editor {
    visibility: visible !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   3. KEEP DESIGNER CONTROLS CLICKABLE
   ================================================================ */

.sp-page-designer .btn,
.sp-page-designer button,
.sp-page-designer a,
.sp-page-designer [role="button"],

.sp-page-editor .btn,
.sp-page-editor button,
.sp-page-editor a,
.sp-page-editor [role="button"],

.page-designer .btn,
.page-designer button,
.page-designer a,
.page-designer [role="button"],

.page-editor .btn,
.page-editor button,
.page-editor a,
.page-editor [role="button"] {
    pointer-events: auto !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   4. CAMPUS360 PAGE ROOTS MUST NOT COVER SERVICENOW
   ================================================================ */

.campus360-training,
.campus360-student-dashboard,
.campus360-opportunities,
.campus360-interviews,
.campus360-trainer-profile,
.campus360-trainer-dashboard,
.campus360-trainer-my-training,
.campus360-trainer-mock-slots,
.campus360-trainer-interview-feedback,
.campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence,
.campus360-trainer-opportunities,
.placement-readiness,
.mock-interview-booking {

    z-index: 1 !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   5. REMOVE FULL-SCREEN FIXED/ABSOLUTE BEHAVIOR
      FROM COMMON CAMPUS360 ROOTS
   ================================================================ */

.campus360-training,
.campus360-student-dashboard,
.campus360-opportunities,
.campus360-interviews,
.campus360-trainer-profile,
.campus360-trainer-dashboard,
.campus360-trainer-my-training,
.campus360-trainer-mock-slots,
.campus360-trainer-interview-feedback,
.campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence,
.campus360-trainer-opportunities,
.placement-readiness,
.mock-interview-booking {

    position: relative !important;

    top: auto !important;
    right: auto !important;
    bottom: auto !important;
    left: auto !important;

    inset: auto !important;

    width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;

    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 600px !important;
    max-height: none !important;

    overflow: visible !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   6. CAMPUS360 COMMON SIDEBARS
   ================================================================ */

.campus360-training .c360-student-sidebar,
.campus360-interviews .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-opportunities .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-student-dashboard .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-trainer-dashboard .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-trainer-profile .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-trainer-my-training .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-trainer-mock-slots .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-trainer-interview-feedback .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence .c360-left-sidebar,
.campus360-trainer-opportunities .c360-left-sidebar,
.placement-readiness .c360-left-sidebar,
.mock-interview-booking .c360-left-sidebar {

    position: relative !important;

    top: auto !important;
    right: auto !important;
    bottom: auto !important;
    left: auto !important;

    width: 285px !important;
    min-width: 285px !important;
    max-width: 285px !important;

    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 600px !important;
    max-height: none !important;

    z-index: 1 !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   7. COMMON CAMPUS360 RIGHT / MAIN CONTENT
   ================================================================ */

.campus360-interviews .c360-right-page,
.campus360-opportunities .c360-right-page,
.campus360-student-dashboard .c360-right-page,

.campus360-training .c360-training-main,

.campus360-trainer-dashboard .c360-main,
.campus360-trainer-profile .c360-main,
.campus360-trainer-my-training .c360-main,
.campus360-trainer-mock-slots .c360-main,
.campus360-trainer-interview-feedback .c360-main,
.campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence .c360-main,
.campus360-trainer-opportunities .c360-main,

.placement-readiness .c360-main,
.mock-interview-booking .c360-main {

    position: relative !important;

    top: auto !important;
    right: auto !important;
    bottom: auto !important;
    left: auto !important;

    width: auto !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: none !important;

    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 600px !important;
    max-height: none !important;

    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    overflow-y: visible !important;

    flex: 1 1 auto !important;

    z-index: 1 !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   8. KEEP SIDEBAR + MAIN CONTENT SIDE BY SIDE
   FOR PAGES USING THE COMMON TWO-COLUMN STRUCTURE
   ================================================================ */

.campus360-interviews,
.campus360-opportunities,
.campus360-student-dashboard,
.campus360-trainer-dashboard,
.campus360-trainer-profile,
.campus360-trainer-my-training,
.campus360-trainer-mock-slots,
.campus360-trainer-interview-feedback,
.campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence,
.campus360-trainer-opportunities {

    display: flex !important;
    align-items: stretch !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   9. BODY / HTML MUST BE SCROLLABLE
   ================================================================ */

html {
    overflow: auto !important;
}

body {
    overflow: auto !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   10. MAKE SURE CAMPUS360 CANNOT SIT ABOVE DESIGNER
   ================================================================ */

.campus360-training,
.campus360-student-dashboard,
.campus360-opportunities,
.campus360-interviews,
.campus360-trainer-profile,
.campus360-trainer-dashboard,
.campus360-trainer-my-training,
.campus360-trainer-mock-slots,
.campus360-trainer-interview-feedback,
.campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence,
.campus360-trainer-opportunities,
.placement-readiness,
.mock-interview-booking {

    z-index: 1 !important;
}


/* ================================================================
   11. MOBILE
   ================================================================ */

@media (max-width: 900px) {

    .campus360-training,
    .campus360-student-dashboard,
    .campus360-opportunities,
    .campus360-interviews,
    .campus360-trainer-profile,
    .campus360-trainer-dashboard,
    .campus360-trainer-my-training,
    .campus360-trainer-mock-slots,
    .campus360-trainer-interview-feedback,
    .campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence,
    .campus360-trainer-opportunities,
    .placement-readiness,
    .mock-interview-booking {

        width: 100% !important;
        min-width: 0 !important;
        min-height: 0 !important;
    }


    .campus360-training .c360-student-sidebar,
    .campus360-interviews .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-opportunities .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-student-dashboard .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-trainer-dashboard .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-trainer-profile .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-trainer-my-training .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-trainer-mock-slots .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-trainer-interview-feedback .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-trainer-placement-intelligence .c360-left-sidebar,
    .campus360-trainer-opportunities .c360-left-sidebar {

        position: fixed !important;

        top: 0 !important;
        left: 0 !important;
        bottom: 0 !important;

        width: 285px !important;
        min-width: 285px !important;
        max-width: 285px !important;

        height: 100vh !important;
        min-height: 100vh !important;

        z-index: 1000 !important;
    }
}


/* ================================================================
   12. DO NOT FORCE POSITION ON DESIGNER CHILDREN
   ================================================================

   IMPORTANT:
   We intentionally DO NOT use:

   .sp-page-designer *,
   .sp-page-editor *,
   .page-designer *

   with position: relative.

   ServiceNow controls need their own internal positioning.
   ================================================================ */</css><name>Campus360 Recovery Styles</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:14:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>fe0f70de096307107f442a080dcb4289</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Campus360 Recovery Styles</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Campus360" source="x_snc_campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_fe0f70de096307107f442a080dcb4289</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 18:08:21</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>
